facts.value: Digital architecture refers to the use of software, computation, simulation, and digital fabrication in design and construction. It includes much more than rendering.
Parametric design helps generate complex relationships and forms.
VR and AR help clients and teams experience a design before construction.
3D printing supports models, components, and prototyping.
AI-assisted tools can speed up iterations, layout studies, and research support.
Start with Parametric Design if you want the theory side, and AI Design Software: Tools for Architects & Designers if you want the current tool landscape.
